articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Native Multimodal Reasoning and Extended Context
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning across text, image, audio, and video inputs with a context window exceeding 1 million tokens. The model demonstrates significant improvements in long-horizon planning tasks and scientific reasoning benchmarks, narrowing the gap toward robust autonomous agent capabilities.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Graduate-Level Science Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind's latest Gemini Ultra 2 model scored above 90% on GPQA Diamond and demonstrated near-expert performance on novel graduate-level physics and biology problem sets. Google emphasized the model's improved chain-of-thought faithfulness and reduced hallucination rates, positioning it as a research co-pilot for professional scientists.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Automotive Assembly Lines
articles.summary: Tesla started deploying its third-generation Optimus humanoid robots in select Gigafactory assembly operations, handling component sorting, bin picking, and light assembly tasks alongside human workers. The Gen 3 units feature improved dexterous manipulation with 22-DOF hands and onboard vision-language models for real-time task adaptation without explicit reprogramming.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Commercial Platform for Construction Sites
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics officially launched its commercial electric Atlas platform tailored for construction environments, featuring autonomous navigation across unstructured terrain and the ability to carry 50 kg payloads up scaffolding and stairs. Hyundai's construction division announced pilot deployments across three major South Korean infrastructure projects beginning Q3 2026.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Tool-Use Agents with Formal Verification Guardrails
articles.summary: Anthropic released a new agentic framework for Claude that allows persistent, multi-step tool use with built-in formal verification checkpoints to constrain agent behavior within operator-defined safety boundaries. The approach uses lightweight theorem-proving at each action step, significantly reducing the rate of unintended side effects in file system and API interactions compared to unconstrained agent baselines.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Gate-All-Around Process Node
articles.summary: TSMC commenced high-volume manufacturing on its A14 (1.4nm-class) process using gate-all-around nanosheet transistors, achieving an 18% speed improvement and 22% power reduction over its N2 node. Major customers including Apple, Nvidia, and Qualcomm are expected to tape out flagship chips on the node by late 2026, continuing the pace of Moore's Law scaling.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Fault-Tolerant Logical Qubit Operations Below Error Threshold
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum published results showing sustained fault-tolerant operations on 12 logical qubits with error rates below the threshold needed for practical quantum error correction, using a hybrid topological-trapped-ion architecture. This milestone represents a critical step toward scalable quantum computing, with the team projecting a 100-logical-qubit system within 18 months.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C to Scale Humanoid Robot Production to 10,000 Units Annually
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion Series C round led by SoftBank and Microsoft Ventures, earmarking funds to build a dedicated manufacturing facility capable of producing 10,000 humanoid robots per year by 2027. The company's Figure 03 robot integrates a custom vision-language-action model co-developed with OpenAI, enabling generalized warehouse and logistics task execution with minimal per-site fine-tuning.
